BrochureContent.Content:
Edel Quinn Properties are proud to present this fantastic Duplex to the market.

The development is just out the Old Laghey Road and sits just over 1km from The Diamond in Donegal Town so it is close to all the amenities of town.

The interior of the house is spacious and in great condition boasting a B3 energy rating. The property is built over first floor and second floor levels. The first floor comprises a separate sitting room and well proportioned kitchen/dining. Upstairs comprises 3 bedroom, one of which with en suite and a good sized bathroom with shower. This property also enjoys a gorgeous back garden.

This property at 31 Brú na Mara, Donegal Town serves as a perfect opportunity suited for first time buyers or indeed anyone looking for a rental investment.
